diagnosis: The proof can be streamlined by applying the integral-zero characterization once, then replacing the resulting almost-everywhere equality by equality of continuous functions. Explicit continuity proofs avoid the heavier `fun_prop` calls.
proof_body:
by
  have h := hg f hf
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg] at h
  · rw [Continuous.ae_eq_iff_eq] at h
    · funext x
      simpa using congrFun h x
    · exact Continuous.inner' f f hf.smooth.continuous hf.smooth.continuous
    · exact continuous_const
  · exact fun x => real_inner_self_nonneg' (f x)
  · exact (IsTestFunction.inner hf hf).integrable
